label: Some POTENCY_1 is not being actualized now
paraphrase: Open premise, unattributed: some potency is not being actualized now. Some being is in potency in a respect without being moved (reduced to act) in it, in the situation the case's premises describe. It is the contradictory of STMT-EVERY-POTENCY-IS-BEING-ACTUALIZED. Physics III.1, 201b8-9 says only that a potency can be inactive (STMT-POTENCY-CAN-BE-INACTIVE), which does not give an inactive potency in this situation, so no claim attributes it.
